description: StrangeBee Helm charts - Renovate config for the hosted Mend app.

Scope (for now): the product image tags strangebee/thehive and thehiveproject/cortex, mirrored in appVersion and the artifacthub.io/images annotation of each Chart.yaml, and the GitHub Actions of the workflows and composite actions (SHA-pinned, grouped in one ci PR). Subcharts are not managed (see enabledManagers).
Each image update also patch-bumps the chart's own version (bumpVersions). Product tags are X.Y.Z-N, so custom regex versioning is used to order the -N revision.

NOTE: Renovate does NOT regenerate helm-docs here (postUpgradeTasks are unavailable on the hosted Mend app), so an image bump arrives with stale README version/appVersion badges. The generate-helm-docs workflow does not fail Renovate PRs for that; it regenerates and commits the docs on merge to main. Pull main before tagging a release so the packaged chart ships an up-to-date README.
Chart-only bumps, non-patch chart versions, subcharts, and CHANGELOG.md entries are handled manually - Renovate does not cover them.

TheHive scenarios: the operator and storage charts, database versions and images pinned in thehive-charts/thehive/scenarios and the Kind workflows are tracked too, grouped in one PR. They are not packaged in the chart, so they do not bump its version.

customManagers.description: Scenario READMEs: helm install <release> <repo>/<chart> --version X, with the registry from the preceding helm repo add

bumpVersions.name: Bump chart version on image updates
